goals: Fix supervisor resume so it no longer discards the abandoned attempt's cost. In src/supervisor/cli.ts resume reconciliation, stop deleting task.cost for unfinished tasks; instead retain the abandoned attempt's cost as prior-attempt provenance on RunTaskState (add a bounded priorAttemptCost field in src/supervisor/types.ts and round-trip it through src/supervisor/store.ts). When a task completes, aggregate the retained prior-attempt cost with the current attempt's cost via aggregateCostTruth so the run-level EvidenceBundle includes every real session and any unavailable abandoned session appears in missing. Keep the new attempt's observations attributed only to its own session id. Add tests proving: an interrupted attempt's observation survives resume and is merged rather than overwritten; the new attempt's observation stays separate; an unavailable abandoned session is recorded in missing. Do not change repair-loop aggregation, cost authority semantics or Node version.
nonGoals: Do not invent provider balance or invoice truth.
Do not attribute abandoned observations to the new attempt's session.
Do not change aggregateCostTruth or repair-loop aggregation behavior.
deliverables: Resume cost retention in the supervisor.
A bounded prior-attempt cost field with RunManifest round-trip.
Regression tests for retention, separation and missing semantics.
forbidden: Do not delete or zero an abandoned attempt's cost.
Do not merge observations from different attempts into one session id.
